Hi Sofia / Luis —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your buying process. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (GNH_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a brief Security Q&A stub we discussed.

Call highlights (short):
- Use case: multi-tenant clinical summarization pipeline for patient intake notes (pilot scope).
- Decision criteria: accuracy on 5k prompts, end-to-end latency <= 300ms 95th, and predictable unit cost under $0.0008/token.
- Key stakeholders identified during call:
  - Economic buyer: Luis Ortega (CFO) — finance and procurement lead on contract forms
  - Clinical sponsor: Dr. Sofia Ramirez — product & clinical outcomes owner
  - Technical reviewer: Priya Narayanan (engineering) — security/architecture review

Asks / next steps I propose:
1) Could you confirm the formal procurement/legal contacts (names & emails) and any vendor approval gates?
2) Can you confirm target decision date for the pilot/POC (you mentioned "late Oct/early Nov")?
3) We suggest a 45-minute "MAP alignment" session to walk the procurement checklist and schedule the security evidence handoff — would Tuesday Oct 19 or Thursday Oct 21 work for you?

Attached: GNH_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP with milestones) and Security_QA_gnosis_v1.pdf (requested evidence list).

If you prefer, Neha (cc'd) can run the MAP workshop and own the agenda.

Thanks — look forward to locking timeline.

Best,

Thanks Marcus — helpful recap. A few clarifications and updates from our side:

- Confirming roles: Luis is the economic buyer; I'm the clinical sponsor. I'll loop in Priya (engineering/security) and our procurement lead, Priya Narayanan (cc'd here), to make sure the proper folks are involved.
- Procurement process: We have a two-stage vendor approval: Security review (evidence + external pen test sign-off) then commercial terms review by procurement/legal. Security needs to see SOC 2 and a pen-test report; procurement will need SLAs and standard contract redlines.
- Timeline: Internal target is to approve a vendor for POC by Nov 5. That gives us a 3-week window for security evidence and commercial review if we start next week.

Preferred times for the MAP alignment session: Oct 19 after 11:00am PT, or Oct 21 between 10:00–11:00am PT.

I'll hand ownership of the procurement logistics to Priya N. (procurement) once she confirms availability.
